description: This source file implements integration with PagerDuty for alerting in a monitoring system, specifically designed for tracking failed and hanging LLM API requests. It defines a class 'PagerDutyAlerting' that extends 'SlackAlerting' to handle fault detection, threshold-based alerting, and alert dispatching via PagerDuty API.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: Class responsible for monitoring API failure and hanging events, and triggering PagerDuty alerts based on configured thresholds. Extends SlackAlerting to incorporate PagerDuty-specific alerting logic.
